title: BibleLens search test set
scope: Global library search; empty private notebook; local source only.

scoring.found: At least one expected target or reviewed acceptable alternative appears. Person and place queries require the named directory target.
scoring.firstGoodRank: One-based row order: Scripture, Research, Stories, People, Places. Includes rows behind Show more.
scoring.firstGoodGroupRank: One-based rank inside the matching result group.
scoring.missing: Expected targets absent from returned rows; a linked chapter does not count as a missing verse row.
scoring.overall: Queries with a useful expected or accepted hit / 50. This measures retrieval, not answer accuracy.
scoring.recall: Returned expected targets / all expected targets, counted per query.
scoring.scopeLimits: Small, hand-picked target sets; not exhaustive relevance judgments. No latency or visual browser checks.
scoring.expectedHit: At least one of the original expected targets appears; kept separate from broader useful results.
scoring.initialVisibleRank: One-based order among the first five rows of each nonempty group; null means the row is collapsed.
scoring.reviewPolicy: The original 160 targets were set before execution. Nine useful verse alternatives were added during self-review. Five queries gain a useful hit; four only improve first-good rank. No original targets were dropped.
